newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady as trader covers short.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady as trader covers short.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Tuesday as a trader saw his prompt short position covered, but swaps eased towards the close with crude, dealers said.
November swaps rose to $224.00 around midday before easing to $221 by the close, about $1.50 below the previous close.

An Alexandria cargo was sold into a trader in ARA at $232.25 cif for arrival by Oct 25. Another Alex cargo, which was put into the October chain on Monday, was kept by a UK refiner on the Tees. Troubled Algerian condensate negotiations for November liftings are due to start this week in London.
